claims: C1 a system or developer message lists the available tools
C2 each listed tool includes documentation of its functionality
C3 each listed tool includes the syntax to use in a message to that tool

concepts.name: system_or_developer_message
concepts.gloss: a message that is either a system message or a developer message

concepts.name: documented_in_message
concepts.gloss: message M includes documentation of tool T's functionality and the syntax to use in a message to T

concepts.name: tool_definition
concepts.gloss: a program that can be called by the assistant to perform a specific task

asserts.read_back: a system or developer message % lists the available tools, each with documentation of its functionality and the syntax to use in a message to that tool

closure.reason: the clause obliges a system or developer message to list tools with documentation; it does not forbid any other way of listing tools, so silence permits
